messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> prod canary (r1234). 15% traffic to canary shards, change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/safemode-unpin (includes quick unpin steps and SOS contacts).

alice: Copy. Are DB migrations included in this deploy?

deploy-bot: No schema changes in this release. Minor config toggle for KV cache warmup enabled.

caroline: Noted. Watch for cache churn; last time warmup caused spike in latency on tail requests. If p50>120ms for 3 consecutive mins, trigger safemode.

derek: Who's owning the backout window? If we need to unpin, I'll take lead. My phone is +1-555-0102.

abob: Quick command for rapid unpin (tested):
```
# repin service images to known-good
./deployctl repin --service inference --tag r1233 --force
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference -n prod
```

caroline: Also add sticky routing cutoff: set feature flag `ff.inference_canary` -> off for canary bucket. That avoids hitting untested optimizer paths.

alice: Where's the smoke test dashboard? I want an easy pass/fail for error rate and latency.

deploy-bot: Smoke: https://dash.redwood/smoke/inference-canary (auto updates). Alert if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms.

derek: OK, plan:_monitor + 7min steady -> escalate. If error_rate spikes >0.5% AND requests_drop >2% -> unpin to r1233. Caroline, can you run unpin if I authorise?

caroline: I can run it. Derek, send :thumbsup: in this thread to authorise. I'll also post exact commands to ops-runbook channel when we hit criteria.

derek: :thumbsup: authorising unpin to r1233 if thresholds breached.

caroline: Copy. Checklist for unpin (short):
- Announce backout in #general and this channel
- Run `./deployctl repin --service inference --tag r1233 --force`
- `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference -n prod` until ready
- Clear KV cache warmup toggle if needed: `infractl config set kv_warmup false`
- Re-run smoke dashboard, confirm error_rate <0.2% for 5 mins
- File incident stub with title "rapid-unpin r1234->r1233"

bob: I saved a tiny helper script in ops-scripts/unpin-helper.sh — works with CI tokens. Will drop link in ops-runbook when we need it.

alice: Thanks. I'm standing by to run post-unpin checks on nightly traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 15% stable for 10m. No alerts. Keep monitoring.

caroline: Good. I'll stay on watch for the next 30m. If anything odd, I'll call Derek and proceed with the checklist.

derek: Thx. Timestamping this plan so oncall know the owner.

deploy-bot: Canary telemetry: p50=38ms p95=142ms error_rate=0.08% recent_qps=420

alice: :raised_hands: nice.

caroline: closing loop: I'll post a short postmortem link template if we do unpin. Otherwise we'll mark this release green at 00:10 UTC.
